name: crit-fumble-core
//: No `version` here on purpose — module.json is the ONLY version source (the hand-bumped copy drifted twice in the old repo; see scripts/module.js MODULE_VERSION).

scripts.//dev:shared: LOCAL DEV ONLY. Links the sibling cfg-shared repo so its edits flow into the code-editor bundle. NEVER release a bundle built while linked — it may contain UNPUBLISHED shared code. Run dev:shared:unlink before a release.
scripts.dev:shared:link: npm --prefix ../../cfg-shared run build && npm link @crit-fumble/shared && npm run build:code-editor
scripts.dev:shared:sync: npm --prefix ../../cfg-shared run build && npm run build:code-editor
scripts.dev:shared:unlink: npm unlink @crit-fumble/shared --no-save && npm install && npm run build:code-editor
scripts.test:foundry:up: npm run test:foundry:stage && docker compose --env-file tests/.env.test -f tests/docker-compose.yml up -d && node tests/integration/shared/foundry-setup.mjs
scripts.test:foundry:down: docker compose --env-file tests/.env.test -f tests/docker-compose.yml down && rm -rf tests/fixtures/.worlds-runtime
scripts.test:foundry:all: npm run test:foundry:up && npm run test:foundry; npm run test:foundry:down
